content: Section 1 focuses on enhancing the quality of care and advancing health outcomes in populations affected by diabetes. It outlines the 2024 Standards of Care in Diabetes, which provide evidence-based recommendations for the prevention, diagnosis, and management of diabetes. These standards emphasize the importance of individualized care, addressing social determinants of health, and implementing strategies to reduce health disparities. The section also highlights the role of a multidisciplinary approach in optimizing diabetes care and improving population health.
